intro.text: The abandonment of Shards by the Knights Radiant.

items.text: Honor broke his promise to Mishram by ordering her capture during an offered peace meeting, damaging Roshar's tones and bonds.
Fear that Surgebinding would destroy Roshar helped convince most Radiants to give up their powers.
Radiants and spren chose together to renounce their oaths, not knowing it would create deadeyes.
At Feverstone Keep, men seized the discarded Blades and turned them on one another.
The loss devastated spren societies, leaving surviving children to rebuild and deep distrust of humans.
